errors.message: Reference to an undeclared value or function
errors.fix: Declare it before use, check for a typo, or add the missing import

errors.message: A value of the wrong type was used
errors.fix: Check the expected type and convert or fix the value being passed

errors.message: Attempted to use a value after ownership of it was moved
errors.fix: Clone the value before the move, or restructure the code to avoid moving it early

errors.message: A mutable borrow conflicts with an existing borrow
errors.fix: Make sure there's only one mutable borrow (or no immutable borrows) active at a time

errors.message: An imported crate or module could not be resolved
errors.fix: Check the import path, and that the crate is listed in Cargo.toml
Check the panic message above for the cause (unwrap on None/Err, assertion failure, etc.)

errors.message: Attempted to access a slice/vector index that is out of range
errors.fix: Check the length of the collection before indexing into it, or use .get() instead
Check the file near the reported location for invalid Rust syntax
Handle the None case explicitly (match, if let, or .unwrap_or/.expect with a clearer message)
Handle the Err case explicitly instead of unwrapping it directly
Check the divisor isn't zero before performing the division

errors.message: Called a method that doesn't exist on this type
errors.fix: Check the type's available methods, an import for the trait it comes from, or a typo
